blocks.text: On the heels of a banner year, multiplatinum global superstar Hilary Duff has released her brand-new Holiday Things EP, out now via Atlantic Records. Listen to the EP and order physical formats — including vinyl and CD — HERE. Co-written by Hilary and produced by her husband, GRAMMY® Award-winning songwriter/producer Matthew Koma (Britney Spears, P!nk), and Brian Phillips (Alec Benjamin, blink-182), the core creative team behind her critically acclaimed sixth studio album luck… or something, the 5-track collection blends cozy holiday nostalgia with Duff’s signature pop sensibility.
